style: Use case: illustration-story / style-transfer. Create ONE standalone square 1:1 illustration for a medieval fantasy atlas location card. Input image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Closely match its gentle playful comic storybook watercolor and colored-pencil illustration, visibly grainy cream watercolor paper, softly irregular painted edges, sunny yellow-green hills, pale turquoise sky, warm ochre roofs, delicate pencil grain and simple charming forms. Calm uninhabited scenic still life, harmonious handmade illustration. Keep the subject clearly readable at small card size, with generous foreground and sky. The final canvas must be exactly square (1:1). No people, no living creatures, no text, no letters, no labels, no watermark, no UI, no collage, no grid, no photorealism, no 3D, no heavy black outlines. Primary subject:

jobs.label: Bauernhof
jobs.subject: A single small thatched farmhouse and timber barn, fenced vegetable beds, a hay cart and gentle wheat fields.

jobs.label: Landgut
jobs.subject: A modest rural estate farmhouse, old stone well, garden, orchard tree and winding country lane.

jobs.label: Anwesen
jobs.subject: An elegant symmetrical medieval manor house with small formal garden, hedges, gravel path and green rolling landscape.

jobs.label: Rittergut
jobs.subject: A small fortified knightly manor with square stone watchtower, timber farmhouse, low palisade and grassy courtyard.

jobs.label: Weingut
jobs.subject: A warm ochre-roofed vineyard estate, orderly rows of purple grape vines, wooden barrels and a sunny hillside path.

jobs.label: Obstplantage
jobs.subject: A peaceful orchard of round apple and pear trees laden with fruit, a small wooden shed, baskets and golden-green meadow.

jobs.label: Viehweide
jobs.subject: A quiet fenced grassy pasture with wooden gates, hay bales, an empty drinking trough and a little field shelter; no animals.

jobs.label: Gestüt
jobs.subject: A charming timber stud farm with long stable building, empty fenced paddocks, hay loft and saddle hanging by an open door; no horses.

jobs.label: Mühle
jobs.subject: One rustic timber windmill with four wooden sails, a little stone mill house, sacks of grain and a curving path through green and golden fields.

jobs.label: Mine
jobs.subject: A clearly visible timber-supported mine entrance in a rocky green hillside, short cart rails, a small ore wagon, picks and pale stone heaps.

jobs.label: Steinbruch
jobs.subject: A small open stone quarry with stepped pale limestone faces, square cut blocks, wooden lifting crane, wheelbarrow and grass along its edges.

jobs.label: Schmiede
jobs.subject: A cozy rural blacksmith workshop with open timber front, brick forge glowing gently, iron anvil, hammer and horseshoes; no smith.

jobs.label: Brauerei
jobs.subject: A small medieval brewery with copper kettle visible through a wide doorway, wooden beer barrels, hop trellis and warm tiled roof.

jobs.label: Fischerei
jobs.subject: A thatched fisher hut beside a gentle river, simple timber dock, empty rowing boat, drying fishing nets and woven fish traps.

jobs.label: Holzfällerlager
jobs.subject: A quiet woodland logging camp with neatly stacked cut logs, a low canvas shelter, chopping stump and hand saw beside spruce trees.

jobs.label: Köhlerei
jobs.subject: A traditional round earth-covered charcoal kiln in a forest clearing, a thin curl of smoke, stacked logs, shovel and a small timber shelter.

jobs.label: Imkerei
jobs.subject: A little rural apiary with several golden straw skeps on wooden stands, flower beds, fruit trees and a tiny thatched shed; no visible insects.

jobs.label: Handelskontor
jobs.subject: A prosperous half-timbered medieval trading office with a small warehouse, covered entry, crates, rolled cloth and barrels by a cobbled lane.

jobs.label: Burg
jobs.subject: A compact fairytale stone castle with rounded red-roofed towers, a crenellated gate, small empty courtyard and green hill; playful peaceful proportions.

jobs.label: Turm
jobs.subject: A solitary slender stone watchtower with a little red pointed roof and blank fluttering pennant, standing beside a winding hillside footpath.

jobs.label: Leuchtturm
jobs.subject: One charming white stone lighthouse on a grassy coastal headland, warm lamp room, low keeper cottage and soft turquoise sea.

jobs.label: Außenposten
jobs.subject: A tiny fortified border outpost with timber palisade, squat stone lookout tower, wooden gate and grassy hillside track.

jobs.label: Grenzposten
jobs.subject: A small half-timbered roadside toll house with a raised wooden barrier, blank pennant, empty road and soft green hills.

jobs.label: Heerlager
jobs.subject: An orderly quiet medieval military camp with two canvas tents, blank pennants, a wooden weapon rack, stacked shields and an unlit fire pit.

jobs.label: Lagerplatz
jobs.subject: A peaceful campsite in a green forest clearing with a small blue canvas tent, stone-ringed campfire, a kettle, rolled blanket and wood pile.

jobs.label: Jägerlager
jobs.subject: A woodland hunting camp with a tan canvas tent, two circular straw archery targets, a bow leaning against a tree and quiet forest path.

jobs.label: Jagdhaus
jobs.subject: A cozy little timber hunting lodge beneath pine trees, steep ochre roof, stacked firewood, wooden bench and empty forest clearing.

jobs.label: Druidenhütte
jobs.subject: A rounded earth-and-timber druid cottage with a mossy roof, small stone-lined doorway, fern garden and ancient trees in a peaceful clearing.

jobs.label: Hexenhütte
jobs.subject: A whimsical crooked timber witches cottage with a mossy thatched roof, brick chimney, little cauldron outside, herb bundles and twisting orchard trees; cheerful not scary.

jobs.label: Schrein
jobs.subject: A little wayside stone shrine with a pitched timber roof, a simple unlettered carved stone centerpiece, wildflowers and a quiet countryside path.

jobs.label: Friedhof
jobs.subject: A serene small medieval churchyard with rounded unlettered gravestones, low stone wall, cypress trees and wildflowers in soft sunlight.

jobs.label: Grabstätte
jobs.subject: An old grassy burial mound with a small stone doorway, a weathered dolmen beside it, scattered flowers and rolling green hills; peaceful archaeological still life.

jobs.label: Ausgrabung
jobs.subject: A modest archaeological excavation in a grassy field, shallow square trenches, exposed ancient stones, wooden hoist, brushes, pottery fragments and rope fencing.

jobs.label: Höhle
jobs.subject: A dark but inviting natural cave mouth between rounded pale rocks at the foot of a grassy hill, ferns, stepping stones and a tiny stream.

jobs.label: Ahnenbaum
jobs.subject: A magnificent ancient oak with rounded golden-green canopy, thick twisting trunk and visible roots, standing alone on a grassy hill surrounded by tiny wildflowers.

jobs.label: Quelle
jobs.subject: A clear spring bubbling between mossy stones into a shallow turquoise pool, reeds, ferns, little stepping stones and soft woodland sunlight.

jobs.label: Berggipfel
jobs.subject: A graceful rocky mountain peak above green foothills, pale blue distance, a narrow winding mountain path and alpine wildflowers in the foreground.

jobs.label: Banditenlager
jobs.subject: A hidden rough woodland camp with patched canvas lean-to, timber lookout, crates, empty barrels and a concealed path through thick shrubs; no bandits.

jobs.label: Hafen / Steg
jobs.subject: A small peaceful wooden river landing with mooring posts, one empty rowing ferry, coiled rope, reeds and a short path to the green bank.

jobs.label: Werft
jobs.subject: A small medieval riverside shipyard with a half-built wooden boat hull on timber supports, simple crane, planks, barrels and calm water.

jobs.label: Poststation
jobs.subject: A charming roadside coaching and post station with half-timbered house, empty wooden carriage, stable door, blank hanging sign and a winding country road.

jobs.label: Schule
jobs.subject: A small medieval village schoolhouse with modest bell turret, a welcoming open door, wooden bench, slate board without writing and flowering garden.

jobs.label: Zirkus
jobs.subject: A cheerful small medieval traveling circus with a red-and-gold striped round tent, blank flags, a painted wooden wagon and an empty sunny meadow.

jobs.label: Wohnhaus
jobs.subject: A single charming small rural half-timbered home with a low thatched roof, a wooden door, flower pots, a tiny vegetable patch and a quiet winding lane.
